d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains why two major climate reports are warning of irreversible damage to Earth's glaciers, ice sheets, sea ice and frozen regions if global warming exceeds 1.5C. Scientists say the damage is already visible, and even bringing temperatures back down may not restore the ice for centuries or millennia. A separate study raises fresh concerns about the stability of the West Antarctic Ice Sheet, with potentially serious consequences for sea levels and coastal communities around the world. What happens when the ice melts faster than the planet can recover?…
